sound_intent.description: Aggressive, club energy phonk arrangement using sample slicing and chopping, emphasizing punchy drums and textured atmospheres.

routing_intent.routing: Separate channels for one-shot hits and texture bed layers with filter and compression buses for drums, bass, and chords.

track_roles.drums: Provides rhythmic drive through sample slices and chopped drum hits.
track_roles.bass: Foundation of groove via sample slices and bass one-shots.
track_roles.chords: Supportive texture using chopped samples and layered pads.
track_roles.melody: Sparse texture using selected sample slices.
track_roles.fx: Provides transitions and energy build-up via one-shot FX samples.

designer_intent.goal: Create a high-energy aggressive phonk arrangement suitable for club settings, leveraging sample manipulation techniques.

presetor_intent.task: Apply mainstream phonk preset adjustments focusing on punchy drums, saturated bass, and textured atmospheres.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns using sample slicing and chopping techniques emphasizing one-shot hits with club energy.

bass_generator.brief: Produce basslines using sample-based techniques and layering for an aggressive, club-oriented phonk feel.

harmony_generator.brief: Create chord textures and pads using sample manipulation methods to support aggressive mood.

melody_generator.brief: Add sparse melodic elements using sample slices and one-shots, avoiding melodic complexity.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement structure ensuring energy curve and section activity match the aggressive, club energy profile.

presetor.brief: Tune effect and instrument presets to fit mainstream phonk style with an aggressive and club energy character.

songgps.brief: Manage arrangement timing, section transitions, and event marker placements to ensure coherent progression.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix routing and dynamic processing plans to preserve raw unprocessed channels while highlighting energy.
